evidenceScope: Authenticated endpoint reports; receipt time is server-observed. UUID joins are diagnostic correlation, not proof of message custody, participants or content. Missing/disabled/offline/legacy endpoint records remain unknown.

retainedLifetime.scope: Server counters over retained records; latest retained client cumulative snapshot per owner. Client and server counters are separate and must not be summed or divided by window event counts.

window.scope: A standalone projection has no comparable monitor baseline; cumulative snapshot values do not establish current-window loss.
